key_findings.best_alpha: expr6 pwK90ZqX (pre_fy1_v1 + cap-decile z40, country): sh0.66/fit0.22/2Y0.63/rn_sh0.61/margin3.15bp. BEST analyst10 result across b10+b11. v1 core field + cap-decile is the winning combination.
key_findings.v1_vs_v2_reversal: CRITICAL: pre_fy1_v1 (core) BEATS pre_fy1_v2 (refined) when cap-decile applied: sh 0.66 vs 0.49, 2Y 0.63 vs 0.42. In b10 (no cap-decile), v2 was better (sh0.50). Cap-decile changes field ranking - v1's raw signal benefits from cap-decile concentration, v2's refined signal does not.
key_findings.cap_decile_effect_on_v2: Cap-decile on v2: sh flat (0.50->0.49), rn_sh CRASHED (0.79->0.44), but 2Y IMPROVED (0.22->0.42). Cap-decile trades rn_sh for 2Y on v2. Net neutral.
key_findings.cap_decile_effect_on_v1: Cap-decile on v1: sh +32% (->0.66), 2Y +186% (->0.63). v1 benefits dramatically. No v1 b10 baseline but clearly strong.
key_findings.densify_redundant: expr1 (no densify) = expr2 (with densify) EXACTLY (identical metrics). densify is redundant for cap-decile grouping. Drop it to save 1 op.
key_findings.country_vs_industry_cap_decile: Country (sh0.49) >> Industry (sh0.14) for cap-decile. Confirms country is the correct group for ASI cap-decile.
key_findings.group_neutralize_vs_group_rank: group_neutralize structure (expr4, sh0.33) UNDERPERFORMS group_rank (expr1, sh0.49). Forum's group_neutralize not better than proven group_rank template.
key_findings.fy2_dead: pre_fy2_v2 (FY2 longer horizon) sh0.08/2Y-0.33. DEAD. FY1 is correct horizon.
key_findings.window_z30_z40_z60: z30 best sh (0.52), z40 best 2Y (0.42), z60 best rn_sh (0.52). Trade-off. z40 is balanced choice.
key_findings.cap_decile_verdict: Cap-decile is forum's untested technique. It HELPS v1 (sh0.66, best ever) but is NEUTRAL for v2. Best analyst10 = pre_fy1_v1+cap-decile+country+z40. Still 0.66 << 1.58 threshold. Analyst10 surprise fields CANNOT reach 1.58 even with all forum techniques adapted to constraints.
key_findings.japan_still_weak: asi_jpn best=0.26 (expr6). All <1.0. Japan structural weakness persists.
